verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents an official CLI, installed via `uv tool install crewai`, that can create, train, run, test and manage crews and flows. It also scaffolds crew, flow, tool, skill and template projects. An AI-native angle is documented: a ready-to-paste setup prompt for coding agents installs the official skills and checks the CLI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in use, and evidence of agent-friendly CLI features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive modes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The CrewAI CLI provides a set of commands to interact with CrewAI, allowing you to create, train, run, and manage crews & flows
Run the following command to install crewai CLI: uv tool install crewai
Create a new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template project.
We added the CLI command `crewai test` to make it easy to test your crew.
It installs the official CrewAI skills, checks the CLI, and points the agent at the right docs before it edits code.
